pages.title: Black Eye
pages.text: $(bold)Unlocking this node gives you the Black Eye and lets you set it in the ancient portal. Its task is a boss kill when that boss is installed.$(br2)$(thing)28 Focal Shards$(n).$(br2)Kill the Netherite Monstrosity.$(br)Without that boss: Place 3,000 cobblestone or stone bricks.
